'''Ka'hadith Jinwa'a''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] underboss of the [[Starbolts]] gang operating in the [[Free Zone]],<ref name="KOTFE6" /> a [[Black market/Legends|black market]]<ref name="Asylum">{{TORcite|type=codex|Asylum}}</ref> on [[Asylum]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] functioning as a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. Armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], Jinwa'a fought in the gang war between the [[Blast Crew]] and [[Starbolts]]<ref name="KOTFE6" /> in [[3631 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> She was killed by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] and [[HK-55]] outside of the [[Oggo's Hideout|hideout]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Oggo]].<ref name="KOTFE6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ka'hadith Jinwa'a appears in Chapter VI: Asylum of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] digital expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
